error_rate.scope: for each request type to an Amazon S3 storage class
error_rate.numerator: InternalError or ServiceUnavailable internal server errors returned by Amazon S3
error_rate.denominator: total requests for that request type during the applicable 5-minute interval
error_rate.exclusions: errors arising directly or indirectly from Amazon S3 SLA Exclusions are omitted

monthly_uptime_formula: 100% - average Error Rates from each 5-minute interval in the monthly billing cycle

applies_to: all other requests not specified in the IA family

billing_basis: total charges paid for the applicable Amazon S3 storage class in the affected AWS Region, or affected AZ for S3 Express One Zone, for the billing cycle
minimum_credit_condition: credit amount for applicable monthly billing cycle must be greater than USD 1
claim_requirements: billing cycle and affected AWS Region
dates and times of each incident of non-zero Error Rates claimed
request logs documenting the claimed incidents
exclusions: factors outside AWS reasonable control including force majeure or Internet/access issues beyond S3 demarcation point
customer equipment, software or other technology
AWS suspension or termination of customer right to use S3
evidence_requirements: complete request denominator by request type/storage class for relevant 5-minute intervals
InternalError and ServiceUnavailable responses for relevant requests
billing charges by applicable storage class and Region/AZ
unresolved: effective_from and immutable official source snapshot/hash
exact aggregation semantics when multiple request types/storage classes contribute to a claim must be proven before ACTIVE implementation
non-USD treatment of the >USD 1 minimum condition
notes: DRAFT only; not approved for financial decisions.
Default absence of durable request logs can make retrospective reconstruction impossible.
Do not substitute CloudWatch request metrics for complete request accounting without validating their suitability against SLA semantics.
Historical incident selection must not assume source_last_updated equals effective_from; ambiguous version boundaries return REVIEW_REQUIRED.
activation_blockers: effective_from/effective_until are not proven from authoritative applicability evidence
immutable official source snapshot SHA-256 is not captured
non-USD treatment of the >USD 1 minimum condition is unresolved
